baseline.accept: every config's fetched bytes were re-accepted through the qualification gate's --accept against the gate's own collected report for that config (bundled from the coordinator, digest recorded per config) BEFORE anything was scored, so the measured bytes are proved to be the qualified bytes per config
baseline.persistence_reference: each config's eval AUC for prev_code_present alone (was this code cited on the licence's most recent strictly-earlier inspection) is recorded in the package measurements (measurements.json -> levels.<config>.persistence_baseline), so any model's headroom over the code's own persistence is checkable per config; the baselines here do not recompute it
baseline.scope: baselines only, through the runner's own contract. No coding agent and no harness comparison was run, and none is implied.
baseline.evidence: .factory/food-baseline-003/reports/output/baseline.json plus the per-config accept/train/validate logs beside it, fetched from the job's staging release and sha256-verified against that release's own asset list

corroborating_measurement.what: an earlier pass measured the same quantity through the same contract on the mid-prevalence config, on the same accepted artifact (re-accepted through --accept first); the suite baseline reproduced it exactly, so this is corroborating history, not a superseded value

scope: One baseline through the runner's training and validation contract. No agent or harness comparison was run and none is implied.

artifact_version_note: artifact_version is derived here: it names the per-level gate-produced versions together, because each level is gated and scored as its own task instance. The gate's own values are in `levels`.
